entities.name: Logged measurement configuration procedure
entities.description: Procedure to configure the UE to perform logging of measurement results while in RRC_IDLE and RRC_INACTIVE states. Applies to logged measurements capable UEs that are in RRC_CONNECTED.

entities.name: LoggedMeasurementConfiguration
entities.description: Message sent from Network to UE to configure logged measurement parameters.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The user equipment that receives the logged measurement configuration and performs measurement logging.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that sends the logged measurement configuration to the UE.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state where UE performs measurement logging according to configuration.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where UE performs measurement logging according to configuration.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE receives the logged measurement configuration.

entities.name: Logged measurements capable
entities.description: Condition that UE must support logged measurements capability.

entities.name: UE information procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by NG-RAN to retrieve stored logged measurement information from UE.

relations.description: The procedure involves sending the LoggedMeasurementConfiguration message.
Network sends the LoggedMeasurementConfiguration message to UE.
Procedure requires UE to be in RRC_IDLE state for measurement logging.
Procedure requires UE to be in RRC_INACTIVE state for measurement logging.
Procedure requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state to receive configuration.
Procedure applies only to logged measurements capable UEs.
UE information procedure is used to retrieve logged measurement information configured by this procedure.
